sql.live:
select m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId", case when m.kind = 'system' and jsonb_typeof(m.meta->'accountId') = 'string'
            then replace(m.body, '{account}',
                         coalesce((select sa.handle from account sa where sa.id = (CASE WHEN (m.meta->>'accountId') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (m.meta->>'accountId')::uuid END)),
                                  '알 수 없음'))
            else m.body end as body,
              m.author_id as "authorId",
              -- 시스템 줄은 누구의 말도 아니다 — 알림에 author 이름을 달지 않는다(제목·부제가 Harkroom 으로 물러난다).
              case when m.kind = 'system' then null else au.handle end as "authorHandle", au.kind as "authorKind",
              c.kind as "channelKind", c.name as "channelName",
              m.meta->>'kind' as "metaKind", m.meta->'failure'->>'code' as "failureCode",
              coalesce(jsonb_array_length(case when jsonb_typeof(m.meta->'ask'->'options') = 'array'
                                               then m.meta->'ask'->'options' end), 0)::int as "optionCount",
              (m.thread_root_id is not null and exists (
    select 1 from message mt where mt.author_id = j.account_id and mt.deleted_at is null
       and (mt.id = m.thread_root_id or (mt.thread_root_id = m.thread_root_id and mt.id <> m.id)))) as "mineThread"
         from push_job j
         join account a on a.id = j.account_id
         join message m on m.id = j.message_id
         join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
         join account au on au.id = m.author_id
         left join inbox i on i.id = j.inbox_id
         left join channel_pref p on p.channel_id = c.id and p.account_id = j.account_id
        where j.id = $1::bigint
          and a.kind = 'human' and a.deleted_at is null and a.disabled_at is null
          and m.deleted_at is null
          and (j.inbox_id is null or i.read_at is null)
          and coalesce(p.notify_level, 'mentions') <> 'none'
          and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = j.account_id))
sql.devices:
select d.id, d.token, d.apns_env as env, coalesce((d.prefs->>'preview')::boolean, false) as preview,
              coalesce((d.prefs->>'badge')::boolean, true) as badge
         from push_device d join session s on s.token_hash = d.session_token_hash
        where d.account_id = $1::uuid and s.expires_at > now()
          and coalesce((d.prefs->>$2::text)::boolean, true)
          and ($3::uuid is null or d.id = $3)
sql.badge:
select count(distinct case when m.thread_root_id is not null and (au.kind = 'agent' and coalesce(m.meta->>'kind', '') not in ('ask', 'failure', 'report'))
                                  then 't:' || m.thread_root_id else 'i:' || i.id end) as n
         from inbox i join message m on m.id = i.message_id join account au on au.id = m.author_id
         join channel ch on ch.id = m.channel_id
        where i.account_id = $1::uuid and i.read_at is null and m.deleted_at is null
          and i.reason in ('mention', 'thread_reply', 'dm')
          and ((ch.kind = 'standard' and ch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = ch.id and cm_vis.account_id = i.account_id))
sql.replies:
select count(*) as n
         from inbox i join message m on m.id = i.message_id join account au on au.id = m.author_id
        where i.account_id = $1::uuid and i.read_at is null and m.thread_root_id = $2::uuid
          and i.reason in ('mention', 'thread_reply') and (au.kind = 'agent' and coalesce(m.meta->>'kind', '') not in ('ask', 'failure', 'report'))
sql.claimSound:
insert into push_thread_sound (account_id, thread_key, sounded_at) values ($1::uuid, $2::text, now())
       on conflict (account_id, thread_key) do update set sounded_at = now()
        where push_thread_sound.sounded_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => $3::float8)
       returning 1
sql.deviceOk: update push_device set last_ok_at = now(), last_error = null where id = $1::uuid
sql.deviceError: update push_device set last_error = $2::text where id = $1::uuid
sql.retry:
insert into push_job (account_id, message_id, inbox_id, device_id, reason, attempts, not_before)
           values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::bigint, $4::uuid, $5::text, $6::int, now() + make_interval(secs => $7::int))
sql.handlesAccount: select id, handle from account where id = any($1::uuid[])
sql.handlesGroup: select id, handle from handle_group where id = any($1::uuid[])
sql.handlesTeam: select id, name from agent_team where id = any($1::uuid[])
sql.pruneSounds: delete from push_thread_sound where sounded_at < now() - interval '1 day'
sql.leakNeedles:
select distinct s.id, s.name, s.kind, v.version, v.sealed
         from secret_grant g join secret s on s.id = g.secret_id
         join secret_version v on v.secret_id = s.id and v.revoked_at is null and v.sealed is not null
        where g.agent_id = $1::uuid
